newsitem.title: USA: Banc One sees EPS dilution in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Banc One sees EPS dilution in 1997.

text.p: Banc One Corp Senior Executive Vice President William Boardman told reporters Monday that the company expects earnings per share to be diluted by 7.3 percent in 1997.
Boardman, speaking at a news conference where executives of Banc One and First USA Inc discussed details of the 7.3 billion stock merger, said there would be no dilution to 1998 earnings.
He declined to be more specific on 1998.
According to First Call, the consensus estimate is $3.59 per share, and for 1998, the consensus is $4.05 per share.
John McCoy, chairman and chief executive of Banc One, told the news conference he expects the credit card chargeoff rate to rise throughout 1997, before peaking late in the year or early in 1998.
McCoy declined to provide any specific figures.
The chargeoff rate, a ratio of loans not being paid to the total loans on the books, has been creeping up for more than a year in the industry.

Questioned about whether Banc One was overpaying for the First USA acquisition, McCoy said the deal is good for Banc One shareholders because it should boost the annual growth rate at Banc One from a 12-13 percent growth rate in earnings to the 15 percent area.
"Our shareholders are getting a faster growing company," he said.
He said it was a fair price for both Banc One and First USA shareholders.
